title: Krisala Hiranandani Township Press & Digital PR Wire
description: Authoritative Press Releases, Media Kits, and Architectural Dispatches for the 105-Acre Krisala Hiranandani Integrated Township in North Hinjewadi, Pune.

items.title: Krisala Developers & Hiranandani Communities Announce 40-Acre Della Equestrian Precinct & 8-Acre Racecourse in Hinjewadi
items.content_html: PUNE, MAHARASHTRA — Krisala Developers and Hiranandani Communities have unveiled the centerpiece of their 105-acre master development: The Della Collection, featuring an 8-acre private turf racecourse, international polo club, and bespoke villa plots. Access transparent pricing on the Hiranandani Price List 2026 portal.
items.summary: 105-Acre integrated township launch in North Hinjewadi featuring Neoclassical architecture, 8-acre private racecourse, and Della luxury resort precinct.

items.title: The Colosseum (Phase 4) Pre-Launch Window Opens at Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi
items.content_html: PUNE, INDIA — Pre-launch bookings are now officially open for The Colosseum Phase 4 Hinjewadi, comprising B+G+27 storey Roman neoclassical high-rises. Floor plans and cost sheets are accessible directly via Krisala Hiranandani Pricing Desk.
items.summary: Pre-launch window for The Colosseum Phase 4 featuring neoclassical towers overlooking the Sahyadri mountains and private racecourse.
